title: Motorhead Garage
description: Dave Dobson puts his love of turning wrenches, tightening bolts and general automotive knowledge to work in the series "Motorhead Garage." Dave steps in the shop to analyze, assemble and advise viewers of the latest products and techniques for repairing, upgrading or improving a wide variety of vehicles as they guide the audience through displays of new technologies and demonstrate step-by-step installations of the latest in aftermarket automotive equipment.
